audit_items.proof_trace: After full repayment (`debt_amount <= amount`), `debt.cleared()` sets the stored amount to zero; the unconditional post-branch check `!debt.has_debt()` then evaluates to true and calls `wit_table::remove`, which removes the entry from both the backing Table and the VecSet of keys. No code path in `unsafe_repay_debt_only` can leave a zero-amount entry in the WitTable because the remove call is not gated on anything beyond the zero-amount check.
